faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Portola Valley?
faq.answer: Portola Valley homeowners typically invest $18,000 to $55,000+ for window replacement projects. This ultra-exclusive Peninsula community features custom estate homes on large lots where premium Marvin, Western Window Systems, or Andersen specifications are the norm. Projects covering 20–35+ windows with custom sizing are common.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Portola Valley?
faq.answer: Yes. Portola Valley requires a building permit for window replacements. The Town's Planning Department may also review projects for consistency with the community's rural, open-space character. Our team manages all Town of Portola Valley permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Portola Valley?
faq.answer: Portola Valley's elite estate market exclusively demands the highest-tier products. We most frequently specify Marvin Ultimate and Elevate for their exceptional customization and natural wood interiors, Western Window Systems for indoor-outdoor living wall installations, and Andersen A-Series for traditional estate homes.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Portola Valley neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve the entire Town of Portola Valley including Alpine Road corridor, Los Trancos Woods, Central Portola Valley, and all estate properties throughout this hillside community. Zip code: 94028.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Portola Valley?
faq.answer: Most Portola Valley projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
